🌿 A man, maybe 30s checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~5 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.

A woman, maybe 40s leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming."

A man, maybe 40s, with a missing fingertip sets out for the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."
Rosa sets out for the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."

🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 40s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 60s breathes "So it bleeds." Jesse breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."

📖 LEARNED: Forage Identification (Level 2). Deeper understanding of forage identification.

🔥 The fire settles. Meriani has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aroha says "And you're still standing." Rosa mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
You don't know what that was. Everyone you've buried, standing up. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
